record.label: Right-inverse-free r63 first-order Gram gate
record.summary: With E0=ker Q_U and C the defect complement, the seam is exact iff {Z in Sym(K): ZN0 lies in D_U} is zero, equivalently the Gram Z -> ||P_C(ZN0)||^2 is positive definite. Here dim D_U=20,832.
record.terminal_criterion: Exhibit a lawful actual-cut positive Gram and lower singular-value bound; Q_U surjectivity and a full-row N0 alone are insufficient.
